title: Patch: the music player's background prefetch waits while the browser asks to save data, as the voice prefetch already does

**Issue #4363 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4363: Patch: the music player's background prefetch waits while the browser asks to save data, as the voice prefetch already does
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

A player on a metered connection who asked their browser to save data still gets the game's music downloaded in the background once a match starts: the danger track, the result stings and every card intro in their hand. The voice lines already wait in that case; the music does not, so the same Save-Data player can silently spend mobile data on music while the voices stay quiet.

## Why

Issue #4329 (R4316000) gated the voice prefetch behind the Save-Data signal: `apps/web/src/audio/engine.ts` checks `savingData()` before fetching voice bytes in the background, and `apps/web/src/net/saveData.ts` documents the signal as shared. The music player never reads it. `apps/web/src/audio/musicDirector.ts` asks for the danger track, the result tracks and each hand card's intro (`preloadHand`, called from `settle()`, plus `sink.preload` on the first view and on station switches), and `apps/web/src/audio/music.ts` `pumpPreload()` fetches those bytes whenever the player is idle and the music or stings are audible (`audible()`/`stingAudible()` only look at the volume settings). The assets are large: `apps/web/public/audio/music` is about 51 MB (the voice folder about 21 MB), a single danger track is ~1.2 MB (`tavern-danger` `bytes: 1263040` in `music-manifest.json`), and a ten-card hand can queue ten more intro fetches. A Save-Data player with the sound on therefore downloads megabytes of music in the background of every game while the 20 MB of voice lines correctly wait.

## Proposal

Thread the existing `savingData()` signal into the music player's background fetching, mirroring the voice prefetch: `pumpPreload()` (and the `fetchCached`/`fetchIntro` paths it drives) does nothing while `savingData()` is true, so held preloads stay held instead of downloaded. Keep every on-demand fetch working: the track the player actually needs now (`sync()`/`decode` for playback, `playIntro`/`playSting` for a card just played) still downloads, exactly as a voice line still plays on demand while its prefetch waits. When the signal clears, the held preloads drain as they do today. No settings UI changes and no manifest changes.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/audio/music.ts` (`pumpPreload`, `fetchCached`, `fetchIntro`)
- `apps/web/src/audio/musicDirector.ts` (preload call sites stay as-is; the sink holds)
- `apps/web/src/net/saveData.ts` (already the shared signal, R2116000)
- SPEC §10.11 (sound) needs no change; the voice precedent is R4316000

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With `saveData: true`, a game view downloads no music bytes in the background (danger/result/intro fetches), while the current track and played-card stings still download and play
- [ ] With `saveData: false`, prefetch behavior is byte-for-byte what it is today
- [ ] `music.test.ts`/`musicDirector.test.ts` gain cases for the held-while-saving and drain-after-clearing behavior that fail without the gate
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test <touched files>` passes; no new network requests appear in the Save-Data path

## Size and risks

Small: one gate plus tests. Risk is under-prefetching (a sting arrives late on a Save-Data connection that just cleared); mitigated because playback fetches are untouched and the held queue drains on the next idle pump.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44866210324)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Thread the existing `savingData()` signal into the music player's background fetching so a Save-Data player downloads no music bytes in the background, exactly as voice lines already wait under R4316000. `pumpPreload()` in `apps/web/src/audio/music.ts` does nothing while `savingData()` is true, leaving held track/intro preloads queued; every on-demand fetch (`sync()`/`decode` for the current track, `playIntro`/`playSting` for a card just played) still downloads. ## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/audio/music.ts` | change | Import `savingData`; new `MusicPlayerOptions.saveData` port; early return in `pumpPreload()` |
| `apps/web/src/audio/music.test.ts` | change | Local `rig()` gains a `saveData` flag; two new `it("R4363000 …")` tests |
| `apps/web/src/audio/musicDirector.test.ts` | change | One new `it("R4363000 …")` integration test with a real player as the director's sink |
| `spec/rulings/R4363000.md` | new | Ruling note (block R4363000–R4363999 verified free), `proven_in` both test files |
| `spec/pending/4363.md` | new | One §11 paragraph for the daily fold |

Must not touch: anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md` (the daily fold owns them); `apps/web/src/audio/musicDirector.ts` (call sites stay as-is, the sink holds); `apps/web/src/net/saveData.ts` (shared signal, unchanged); `apps/web/src/audio/engine.ts`; any manifest or settings UI. Governing notes: SPEC §10.11 (unchanged), `spec/rulings/R2116000.md`, `spec/rulings/R4316000.md`.

## Steps

1. Re-read SPEC §10.11 (`spec/10-engine-guide.md`, `### 10.11 Audio`), `spec/rulings/R4316000.md`, and `pumpPreload()` at `apps/web/src/audio/music.ts:538-550` before editing.
2. In `apps/web/src/audio/music.ts`, add `import { savingData } from "../net/saveData.ts";` beside the other relative imports (line 33-37 area), copying the voice precedent in `engine.ts:63`.
3. In `MusicPlayerOptions` (`music.ts:80-87`), add `saveData?: () => boolean;` with the comment `// default shared savingData() (R4363000); tests pass an explicit port`, mirroring `engine.ts:139`. Inside `createMusicPlayer`, beside `const settings = …` (line 179), add `const saveData = options.saveData ?? savingData;`, mirroring `engine.ts:260`. Name the constant `saveData`, as the engine does.
4. In `pumpPreload()` (`music.ts:538`), insert `if (saveData()) return;` immediately after the existing `if (busy || disposed || loadedManifest === null) return;` guard, with a one-line comment citing R4363000. This returns before `heldPreload`/`heldIntroPreload` are drained, so held ids stay queued. Do not touch `fetchCached`, `fetchIntro`, `decode`, `decodeIntro`, `sync`, `playIntro`, `playSting`, `preload`, `preloadIntros`, or `setBusy`: the gate sits only in `pumpPreload`, so on-demand playback still fetches. No new subscription is added: like the voice prefetch, there is nothing to subscribe to (the signal reads `navigator` live), and held preloads drain on the next pump (`preload`, `preloadIntros`, `setBusy(false)`, tables load), which the issue accepts as the mitigation.
5. In `apps/web/src/audio/music.test.ts`, extend the local `rig()` (lines 58-91) with an options flag, e.g. `saveData?: () => boolean`, forwarded as `saveData: options.saveData` into `createMusicPlayer`. Default absent (uses the real signal, false in jsdom) so all existing tests are unaffected.
6. In `spec/rulings/R4363000.md`, write the note in `spec/README.md` "Note format": front matter `id: R4363000`, a one-line title answering what the music prefetch does while the browser asks to save data, `cards: "§10.11, R2116000, R4316000, issue #4363"`, `proven_in` listing `apps/web/src/audio/music.test.ts` and `apps/web/src/audio/musicDirector.test.ts`. Body: while `navigator.connection.saveData` is true the player fetches no background music bytes (track preloads, intro preloads); the current track and a played card's intro/sting still fetch on demand; held preloads drain on the next pump after the signal clears; Hearthstone makes no save-data decision, this follows the browser signal per [[R2116000]] and [[R4316000]]; rejected: prefetching anyway, since the ~51 MB music folder is what the player asked to avoid. Write every ruling/section reference as a `[[…]]` link and every other number plain, or `cargo jackioh spec check` fails. Note: the note must exist because code and test titles will cite R4363000, and spec check fails on a cited R-id with no note.
7. In `spec/pending/4363.md` (new file), write the single paragraph `11-rulings.md` would end with, copying the shape of `spec/pending/4349.md`: `**[[R4363000]] … (issue #4363, 2026-11-21)**: …`.
8. Run `cargo jackioh spec check` and the two vitest files (exact commands in Tests), then `cargo fmt --check` if any Rust-side file was touched (none expected).

## Tests

- `apps/web/src/audio/music.test.ts`, `it("R4363000 held track and intro preloads fetch nothing while the browser asks to save data, and the current track still plays")`: rig with `saveData: () => true`; `player.preload(["tavern-danger"])`; `player.preloadIntros(["intro-a"])`; `await settle()`; assert `fetch.urls()` is empty. Then `player.request({ track: "tavern-1" })`; `await settle()`; assert `started()` is `["tavern-1"]` and `urls()` holds only `/audio/music/tavern-1.m4a`. Then `player.playIntro("intro-a")`; `await settle()`; assert `/audio/music/intro-a.m4a` fetched exactly once. Fails without the gate at the first assertion.
- `apps/web/src/audio/music.test.ts`, `it("R4363000 held preloads drain on the next pump after the signal clears")`: mutable `let saving = true`, rig with `saveData: () => saving`; preload both ids; `await settle()`; assert empty. Set `saving = false`; trigger an idle pump with `player.setBusy(true); player.setBusy(false);` (mirrors the existing B58 test at line 433); `await settle()`; assert `urls()` contains `/audio/music/tavern-danger.m4a` and `/audio/music/intro-a.m4a`. Fails without the gate at the first assertion.
- `apps/web/src/audio/musicDirector.test.ts`, `it("R4363000 a game view under Save-Data fetches no background music, then drains and still stings on demand")`: build a real player as the sink — `createAudioEngine({ createContext: fakeContextFactory({ decodedSeconds: 30 }).create, speech: null, visibility: () => "visible" })`, `engine.unlock()`, `new FakeFetch()`, mutable `saving` flag, `createMusicPlayer({ engine: () => engine, manifest: MANIFEST, fetchBytes: fetch.fetchBytes, focus: null, saveData: () => saving })` (`focus: null` keeps focus level at 1 without DOM). Copy the `loop()` helper and `MANIFEST` from `music.test.ts:34-52` (tavern station tracks plus `intro-a`). Director: `createMusicDirector({ sink: player, manifest: MANIFEST, cards: { "core-097": { intro: "intro-a" } }, settings: () => ({ ...DEFAULT_AUDIO_SETTINGS }), subscribeSettings: (l) => () => {}, rotation: () => 0 })`. Drive `director.onView(midGame({ you: emptySide("p1", { hand: [card({ defId: "core-097" })] }) }))` then `director.settle()`; `await settle()`; assert no fetched url is `tavern-danger`, `victory`, or `intro-a` (the current track `tavern-1` may fetch on demand — that is allowed). Set `saving = false`, pump with `player.setBusy(true); player.setBusy(false);` (director-side `preloaded` dedupe means a second `settle()` would not re-request, so the pump must be player-level); `await settle()`; assert `tavern-danger` and `intro-a` fetched. Then `director.onEvent(played("core-097"), view)`; `await settle()`; assert a sting/intro started (player `log()` holds a `start` for `intro-a`). Fails without the gate at the background-silence assertion. Ensure audible settings (`muted: false, music > 0, sfx > 0`) via `writeAudioSettings` in the test and restore defaults after (mirror `music.test.ts:124-135`), since `audible()`/`stingAudible()` also gate `pumpPreload`.
- Commands: `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/music.test.ts`, then `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/musicDirector.test.ts`, then `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] With `saveData: true`, background track/intro preloads fetch nothing while the current track and a played card's intro/sting still download and play
- [ ] With `saveData: false`, prefetch behavior is byte-for-byte today's (existing suites green, no test touched except the rig's additive option)
- [ ] New `R4363000` cases in both test files fail without the gate (held assertion) and pass with it
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test` on both touched files passes; `cargo jackioh spec check` passes; no new network requests in the Save-Data path
- [ ] Ruling note plus `spec/pending/4363.md` paragraph added; `spec/11-rulings.md`, `INDEX.md`, `CARDS.md` untouched; every decision the task left open recorded below in Risks or Open questions

## Risks

- Gating `fetchCached`/`fetchIntro` themselves instead of `pumpPreload` would break on-demand playback, since `decode`/`decodeIntro` share those paths; the plan gates only `pumpPreload`, and the on-demand test pins this.
- Under-fetching after the signal clears (a sting arriving late): accepted in the issue; playback fetches are untouched and the held queue drains on the next pump. No settings subscription is added, mirroring the voice precedent, which also has none.
- Director-side `preloaded` dedupe means a second `settle()` does not re-trigger the sink, so the drain test must pump at the player level (`setBusy` cycle); the steps say so explicitly.
- `musicDirector.test.ts` currently never touches global audio settings; the integration test sets them and must restore them so neighboring tests keep today's defaults.
- `spec check` sensitivity: any `R4363000` string in code comments or test titles requires the note, the `it("R4363000 …")` word match, and the `proven_in` listing — all three are in the plan; no other new R-id is introduced.

## Open questions

None.
```
